_doc: The release cycle's ROTATION pool. Data, not code: every cycle builds the anchors (scripts/release_cycle.json) plus `picks_per_cycle` blueprints taken from `blueprints` -- slot 1 repeats the previous cycle's failing pick, the rest are the next blueprints never built in THIS ORDER (never filesystem order, never at random), and a certified blueprint is never re-run (scripts/release_cycle.py rotation_state / select_rotation). Every *.json beside this index must be listed in it. The hardwiring gate forbids each blueprint's id, name and vertical as a string literal in Factory code (scripts/scan_hardwiring.py form blueprint_name), so nothing in the Factory can branch on which blueprint is running.
